hook.text: Bacillus thuringiensis—Bt—is a soil bacterium that produces crystals lethal to specific insects. Nothing else.

buildup.text: When caterpillars eat Bt crystals, their guts dissolve. The toxin is harmless to humans, birds, and fish.

discovery.text: Organic farmers have sprayed Bt as a natural insecticide since the 1930s. It's approved for organic use.

twist.text: Scientists put the Bt gene directly into crops—creating GM Bt cotton and corn. Organic purists objected.

climax.text: Bt crops reduced insecticide spraying by 37% globally while increasing yields for smallholders.

punchline.text: Same toxin, different delivery. Sprayed is organic. Bred-in is controversial.

quiz.question: What makes Bt toxin unusual as an insecticide?
options: It's lethal to specific insects but harmless to humans and most other organisms

details.summary: Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) is a soil bacterium that produces proteins toxic to specific insect groups. Used as an organic-approved spray and engineered into transgenic crops, Bt is the most commercially successful biological insecticide in history.
details.whyItMatters: Bt technology is central to both organic farming (as a spray) and biotechnology (as transgenic Bt crops). Its specificity and effectiveness make it a cornerstone of modern pest management, but resistance threatens its future.
takeaways: Bt produces crystal proteins toxic to specific insects but harmless to most other organisms
It is approved for use in organic farming as a natural microbial insecticide spray
Bt crops (corn, cotton) have reduced insecticide use by millions of kilograms annually

faq.question: How does Bt kill insects without harming humans and animals?
faq.answer: Bt produces crystal proteins (Cry toxins) that only become active in the alkaline gut of specific insects. Human and animal stomachs are acidic, so the proteins are harmlessly digested. Each Bt strain targets specific insect groups like caterpillars, beetles, or mosquito larvae.

faq.question: What is the difference between Bt spray and Bt crops?
faq.answer: Bt spray applies the bacterium externally and breaks down in sunlight within days—it is organic-approved. Bt crops are genetically engineered to produce Cry toxins continuously in plant tissues. Bt crops are more effective but are not allowed in organic farming and face resistance evolution.
